-- Pure check: does a request path stay inside its directory?
-- Rejects "..", absolute paths, and any path that climbs out of the base.
is_inside(path: str) -> bool =
  ex is_inside("a.txt") == True
  ex is_inside("sub/../a.txt") == True
  ex is_inside("../x") == False
  ex is_inside("sub/../../x") == False
  ex is_inside("/etc/passwd") == False
  let parts = path.split("/")
  -- An empty first component means an absolute path (or an empty path).
  if parts[0] == ""
    return False
  var depth = 0
  for p in parts
    if p == ".."
      depth -= 1
      if depth < 0
        return False
    else
      if p != "" and p != "."
        depth += 1
  True

-- Returns the text of notes/path, or "" when the path escapes notes
-- or the file is missing or unreadable.
read_public(path: str) -> str uses fs =
  post is_inside(path) or out == ""
  if is_inside(path) == False
    return ""
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    let text = fs.read(path) else ""
    text

test_inside() =
  assert is_inside("a.txt") == True
  assert is_inside("sub/../a.txt") == True
  assert is_inside("../x") == False
  assert is_inside("sub/../../x") == False
  assert is_inside("/etc/passwd") == False
